description: Dictate text with your voice using your browser's speech recognition. Live interim results, final transcript, multiple languages and one-click copy.

faqs.a: Speech recognition is supported in Chrome and Edge on desktop and Android. Safari and Firefox currently do not support it.
faqs.q: Which browsers support speech to text?

faqs.a: Click Start, allow microphone access when asked, and speak clearly. Click Stop when you are done.
Recognition happens through your browser's built-in speech service, which may send audio to the browser vendor for processing.

howto: Choose your language from the dropdown.
Click Start and allow microphone access.
Speak — interim results appear live, final text lands below.
Click Copy to copy the transcript.
title: Speech to Text
